comment: Shared by internal/config TestActiveConnectorsParityFixture and cli/tests/test_active_connectors_parity.py (GAP-0707). Each case is a config.yaml body (config_version 9 and data_dir are added by the tests) and the primary, roster (ActiveConnectors / active_connectors), policy set (PolicyConnectors / policy_connectors) and per-connector rule_pack both sides must resolve.

cases.name: two_entry_roster_named_primary
cases.config:
guardrail:
  connector: kiro
  rule_pack: default
  connectors:
    kiro: {}
    codex:
      rule_pack: strict

cases.name: one_entry_for_another_connector
cases.config:
guardrail:
  connector: kiro
  rule_pack: default
  connectors:
    codex:
      rule_pack: strict
cases.note: 1.0.8 semantics: an entry puts its connector on the roster with its own settings; guardrail.connector names the primary

cases.name: one_entry_names_the_primary_by_alias
cases.config:
guardrail:
  connector: claudecode
  connectors:
    claude_code:
      rule_pack: strict

cases.name: disabled_entry_stays_on_the_roster
cases.config:
guardrail:
  connector: kiro
  connectors:
    kiro: {}
    codex:
      enabled: false

cases.name: roster_without_primary_prefers_claw_mode
roster_without_primary_first_sorted_when_mode_is_not_listed
retired_primary_keeps_first_sorted_key
cases.config:
claw:
  mode: kiro
guardrail:
  connector: openhands
  connectors:
    codex: {}
    kiro: {}
cases.note: until 1.1: a retired singular connector is replaced by the first sorted roster key on both sides, even when claw.mode lists another

cases.name: retired_mode_without_primary_first_sorted_key

comment_boot: boot_cases are final config.yaml bodies. Go (internal/config TestGuardrailBootSetParityFixture) checks Config.GuardrailBootSet (multi, enabled, disabled); Python (cli/tests/test_active_connectors_parity.py) checks that config set/unset refuses a file exactly when config_set is 'refused', and that every file whose shared boot sets up a proxy connector (proxy_boot_fails) is refused, so a successful edit never saves a file the gateway rejects (GAP-0588).
